name: Botanica MontAzure
shortDescription: Hillside luxury pool villas of 3 to 5 bedrooms in Kamala, about 1.4 km from Kamala Beach, by Botanica Luxury Phuket.
description:
Botanica MontAzure is a development of luxury pool villas in Kamala on Phuket's west coast, built by Botanica Luxury Phuket, the developer of the Botanica villa communities. Marketing material describes mountain backdrops and a five-minute drive to Kamala Beach; FazWaz measures Kamala Beach at about 1.4 km in a straight line.
The developer's factsheet confirms 41 villas, with 3 to 5 bedrooms, 3 to 7 bathrooms, villa areas of 372 to 1,072 sqm on plots of about 625 to 2,277 sqm, and a pool of 5.7 by 13 m. FazWaz lists the project on about 49,200 sqm and as completed in June 2026. Two parking spaces per villa and 24-hour security are listed. Common-area fees are listed at THB 20 per sqm per month with a THB 100,000 sinking fund, and pets are not allowed.
The complex sits among well-known Kamala landmarks such as Twinpalms MontAzure and the InterContinental resort. The developer advertises prices from THB 38.9 million to 140 million; prices are portal asking prices and change often, so ask us for current availability.
